source: Servicio de Impuestos Internos (SII) — Estadisticas de empresas por comuna
caveat: Domicile/HQ artifact: the commune is the firm's registered domicilio or casa matriz, not the physical work establishment. Multi-site firms attribute all workers to HQ, concentrating counts in business-district communes (Las Condes, Santiago, Providencia). Use as daytime-activity exposure proxy with awareness of this bias. REFERENCE-ONLY — not wired to any displayed metric.
